    pr0, pr1 = min(r for r, c in pattern_cells), max(r for r, c in pattern_cells)

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Mirror the colored motif horizontally into the zero rectangle."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = grid[0][0]
    motif = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             for c, value in enumerate(row)
             if value != background and value != 0]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]

    top = min(r for r, c in motif)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in motif)
    left = min(c for r, c in motif)
    right = max(c for r, c in motif)
    ztop = min(r for r, c in zeros)
    zleft = min(c for r, c in zeros)
    height, width = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1
    if (max(r for r, c in zeros) - ztop + 1,
            max(c for r, c in zeros) - zleft + 1) != (height, width):
        raise ValueError("zero rectangle must match motif dimensions")

    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            out[ztop + r][zleft + c] = grid[top + r][right - c]
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo = [[2] * 12 for _ in range(12)]
    pattern = [[1, 3, 3, 1], [1, 1, 3, 1],

        demo[r][1:5] = row
    for r in range(7, 11):
        demo[r][4:8] = [0] * 4
    expected = [row[:] for row in demo]
    for r, row in enumerate(pattern, 7):
